description:
[Interviews] Change the state of an interview/position (e.g. open, closed).

Changes the lifecycle status of an interview or position (draft, active, archived, preparing, completed, deleted) and/or manages its embed key. Provide at least one of `status` or `is_embedded`.

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

is_embedded.description: Controls iframe embedding of the interview on an external page. When true, ensures an embed key exists (returns embed_id/embed_signing_key, used to authenticate/sign the iframe embed). When false, removes the embed keys (disables embedding).

position_id.description: Interview definition id or position id whose state should change.

name: set_interview_state

result.description: Returns `{ embed_id, embed_signing_key }` when an embed key was created/returned (is_embedded=true), otherwise `{ success: true }`.

title: Change interview state
